state_refutations.why: The requirement names Odoo ('Every Amazon, Noon, Trendyol and Odoo connection ... moves from disabled to working one deliberate, logged step at a time') and says remaining 'Nothing', but at origin/main c5c04b7b (read from code, not run; the PR 83 and PR 75 heads leave these files unchanged) the Odoo half fails. (1) OdooConnectionController::settings creates the row with SalesChannelAccount::create, not ChannelAccountService::create: capabilities connection_test and financial_reconciliation are already held and nothing is audited. (2) No Odoo screen enables the row, turns dry run off or records the accounting_posting approval; ChannelAccountService::approveScope and setWriteEnabled refuse until connection_status is ok, and only the Amazon, Trendyol and noon connectors ever record ok (config sales_channels.connectors has no 'odoo'; ChannelConnectorRegistry::for throws for it). Every Odoo test builds the row already enabled, approved and live (tests/Support/BuildsOdooWorld.php odooConnection()). (3) The transport refuses calls for a disabled account, so a working Odoo connection is an enabled row. SalesChannelsSyncCommand runs SalesChannelAccount::enabled() with no channel filter every five minutes (ScheduleDefinition line 109) and ChannelSyncService::permitted() reaches connectors->supports() for the preset financial_reconciliation capability, which throws RuntimeException for channel 'odoo'. The run stops at that row and every account with a higher id is not synced. This is Discovery E12-F23 (P1, INFERRED, still open); no test runs a channel command with an Odoo row. Independence of integration accounts is therefore not met and at least one criterion is MISSING. The assessor never cites E12-F23. The alternative is to narrow H2-05 to the three channel accounts and move the Odoo lifecycle into H2-04 as MISSING criteria, but then the functional text must drop Odoo.

Two overclaims found: the request-level fail-closed audit (criterion downgraded MET to CODED) and wording or provenance errors carried as six field corrections (contract origin, audit section cite, role check after #84, token expiry not audited, two-files test only at app#6, fail-closed note). Step 2: exists_now and done_in_drafts of all 18 requirements checked at least in part against the trees: 11 routes, 9 migrations and the console commands per stack head (71, 79, 80, 84), config defaults and ceilings (480/1440, 60/1440, 5 sessions, 5 per minute, 120 per minute, MFA 5/10/15, window 30/92), PR numbers, bases and head SHAs against the INDEX files, no platform_admin code on any main (lavkoo docs and translation text only), no storefront_country, legal_entity or order currency on main, seller topics and FCM token column, 1.0.0+3 against 2.0.1, app diffs against main (two seller files, three CustomTextFieldWidget switches, 94 and 43 keys), absence of oversell, step-up, export, push, health, pause-mode and version-gate code in all 93 lavkoo branches and of platform-admin code in all lavkooapp branches, Discovery-02 F-xx, T-xx, s.2.2/2.3/5.2/6/7/8 references, contract s.8-12 item numbers, charter s.3/s.5/s.8 and original plan lines 389-391, 416-418, 445-459. Step 3: all 97 evidence triples re-run with git grep -c -F at the stated ref and path, all pass (count at least 1), so no triple correction. Step 4: GCC-20 doc lines 1-104 and DECISIONS 65-67 re-read bullet by bullet against plan_lines; every bullet, discovery item 1-9, AC1-AC7 and the unit scope text maps to at least one requirement, so missing_requirements is empty (the customer-app-unaffected bullet, line 10, sits in L-17 plan_lines 8-11 without its own criterion; judged covered by the backend isolation tests and by no platform-admin code in any lavkooapp branch). States: all 18 stand (6 IMPLEMENTED IN DRAFT, 8 IN PROGRESS, 4 NOT STARTED), none is higher than the evidence allows. Not done: no Flutter test was run and the app CI step results are not in the data pack (CODED stays right); CI and GitHub were not queried.
